name: @blacksite-agent/llm
description: Provider-neutral model transport for Blacksite: one event stream from Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Bedrock and ChatGPT.

scripts.api: api-extractor run -c api-extractor.json && api-extractor run -c api-extractor.node.json && api-extractor run -c api-extractor.testing.json
scripts.check:api: npm run build && npm run api
scripts.update:api: npm run build && api-extractor run --local -c api-extractor.json && api-extractor run --local -c api-extractor.node.json && api-extractor run --local -c api-extractor.testing.json
